assets.name: berry-bush
assets.detail: A low, broad, naturally rounded wild berry shrub, much wider than tall. Dense overlapping clusters of moss-green and dark olive leaves, with about 8 clearly visible clusters of ripe crimson red berries distributed naturally across front and top. A few woody twigs visible under the foliage, tiny root stem at bottom center. Organic asymmetry and soft rounded leafy masses, attractive painted leaves with lighter upper surfaces, no giant tree trunk. Main silhouette width-to-height about 1.5:1. Elevated three-quarter view. No flowers.

assets.name: sandstone-ruin
assets.detail: One compact ancient sandstone ruin composed of three weathered square columns of different broken heights on a low cracked rectangular stone foundation. Two taller columns support one fractured lintel, the third is a shorter broken column beside them. Warm honey-ochre sandstone blocks, softened chipped edges, visible construction joints, a few integrated rubble blocks resting on the same foundation. Subtle old carved border accents without readable symbols. Elevated three-quarter orthographic view with visible top planes and interior gaps. Broad compact silhouette approximately 1.3:1 width-to-height. Foundation centered near bottom, no ground or terrain outside it. Make it believable ancient masonry, not flat rectangles.

assets.detail: One compact pile of THREE naturally interlocking small driftwood branches, lying flat. Warm grey-tan wood grain, rounded water-worn ends, a few knotted stubs and delicate splits. Distinct from a fresh cut log: no bark, no leaves, no mushrooms, no grass.
